title: Serenity on Fitz
description:
This stylish place to stay is perfect for group trips.

The space
3 Story Townhouse. Main living space on 2nd Floor with Balcony overlooking front. The Bedrooms  are located on 3rd and 1st Floors. All Bedrooms have attached bathroom. The 1st Floor garage has a hang out space and Ping Ping Table.

Guest access
Entire home

Other things to note
Security Disclosure: There are 3 security cameras on site (1)  outside front door, (2) outside back driveway, and (3) outside above 2nd floor balcony.

Near the railway: Close proximity to the Donelson Train Station - commuter rail station to Lebanon/Mt Juliet/Hermitage/Broadway/Downtown Nashville.
